entries.reason: The Ties That Bind / Eternity Cake (Item 8791): decided quest-exclusive for 0.7.0. The wiki's only non-quest acquisition is the Ceremony of Eternal Bonding plans sold on the Online Store, but every plan includes the cake, the free Standard Plan too ({{onlinestore|0}}, 'available to all Plans' on https://ffxiv.consolegameswiki.com/wiki/Ceremony_of_Eternal_Bonding), and it is handed out as the fixed reward of this quest, which every plan runs. entries.fix: none: kept quest-only by decision; re-check if the cake is ever sold outside the ceremony (then add item 8791 to curated/online_store.json)
